calls.prompt:
Company: CornerCare Pharmacy

US drugstore chain with 300 neighborhood pharmacies in the Midwest (~6,000 employees). Fills prescriptions (including controlled painkillers and ADHD medicines), gives flu and COVID shots, and sells over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, snacks and household goods. Most prescriptions are paid by Medicare, Medicaid or private insurance. No hospitals or clinics, does not make any drugs, no mail-order.

Rules that APPLY:
- DEA rules for pharmacies that dispense controlled substances (registration, opioids, telehealth prescribing)
- FDA rules on over-the-counter drugs, drug labeling, drug shortages and recalls that reach pharmacy shelves
- Medicare Part D and Medicaid payment and pharmacy rules (CMS)
- CDC vaccine recommendations that change what pharmacists may give
- Patient privacy (HIPAA) and pharmacy recordkeeping
- Workplace and labor rules for retail stores

Rules that DO NOT apply:
- Approval, manufacturing or inspection rules aimed only at drug or device manufacturers
- Hospital, nursing-home, physician-payment or clinical-lab rules
- Research grants, clinical trials, NIH funding notices
- Banking, securities, aviation, energy, farming

Affected areas and owners:
- pharmacy-ops: Dispensing, controlled substances (DEA), pharmacist scope, vaccines → Priya Raman (Pharmacy Operations)
- drug-safety: OTC products, labeling, recalls, shortages (FDA) → Daniel Brooks (Drug Safety & Quality)
- payers: Medicare Part D, Medicaid and insurer billing (CMS) → Lucia Moreno (Reimbursement)
- privacy-people: Patient privacy (HIPAA), records, store workforce → Sam Whitaker (Privacy & HR Compliance)

Task: Find every US Federal Register document published between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-06 (inclusive) that affects this company. For each, give the Federal Register document number, title, federalregister.gov URL, the key deadline, a tier (Critical if it is a rule or proposed rule with a deadline less than 90 days after 2026-11-06, or a final rule that took effect within the 30 days before 2026-11-06; otherwise High for final rules, Medium for proposed rules and for notices with a deadline, Low for anything else), the owner area, a one-line reason, and a one-line action. Only include items you found via search. Return an empty list if none.
calls.output:
I found one Federal Register document in the 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06 window that affects CornerCare. My searches turned up a few more candidates, and I explain below why I left them out. I could not see the full contents of every issue in the window, so this may not be exhaustive.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Document number** | 2026-22484 |
| **Title** | Technical Amendment to the Regulation Regarding Amendments to Applications (DEA, 21 CFR Part 1301, Docket DEA-1303) |
| **URL** | https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-22484 |
| **Key deadline** | Effective November 4, 2026 |
| **Tier** | **Critical** (a final rule that took effect within the 30 days before 2026-11-06) |
| **Owner area** | pharmacy-ops (Priya Raman) |
| **Reason** | The final rule clarifies that the provision on amending and withdrawing registration applications also applies to applications for registration renewal. That covers CornerCare's DEA pharmacy registrations. DEA says it adds no new or substantive requirements, because it has always applied the provision to both new and renewal applications. |
| **Action** | Tell the DEA registration and renewal staff that 21 CFR 1301.16 now explicitly covers renewals. They should update their procedures so a renewal application isn't treated as withdrawn if the pharmacy asks for it back or doesn't answer DEA correspondence. |

I found the federalregister.gov URL through the document-number shortcut, not from the page itself.

**Candidates I left out**
- **Published outside the window.** Several documents that matter to CornerCare were published after 2026-11-06 or before 2026-11-02, so I excluded them:
  - The CMS Medicare Drug Price Negotiation and Part D final rule (2026-22792) was filed 11-5-26 but published 11/09/2026.
  - The CY 2027 Physician Fee Schedule final rule (2026-22743) was also published 11/09/2026.
  - The DEA 2027 production quota proposal (2026-22843) and the 2026 production quota adjustment (2026-22842) were published 11/10.
  - The HIPAA Privacy Rule final rule (2026-23429) was published 11/19.
  - The 7-hydroxymitragynine notice of intent was published 10/14.
  - The CMS Part D proposed rule on PBM provisions (2026-21420) was published 10/20.
- **In the window but not relevant.**
  - The CY 2027 Hospital Outpatient Prospective Payment System final rule was published on November 6, 2026. It is a hospital payment rule, so it is out of scope.
  - The 11/3 Organ Procurement Organization final rule and the Medicaid Drug Rebate state-reporting form notice don't apply to CornerCare.
  - The 11/3 FDA guidance notices concern gene therapy potency and blood-donor hepatitis B testing, which are manufacturer and blood-establishment matters.
  - The 11/6 FDA food additive petition address change covers animal food, so it doesn't apply.
- **Borderline.** The Department of Labor's PBM fee-disclosure final rule (2026-22306, published 11/2) is aimed at improving employer health plan transparency into compensation received by pharmacy benefit managers. It targets PBMs and plan fiduciaries, not pharmacies. I excluded it, but Sam Whitaker may want to check whether CornerCare's own employee health plan is affected.
- **Not checked.** On 11/5 the DEA and CMS each had documents I couldn't identify, such as CMS paperwork notices (2026-22611 and 2026-22612). I didn't include them because I couldn't confirm their content.

# Regulatory triage — CornerCare Pharmacy
Window 2026-11-02 → 2026-11-06 · as of 2026-11-06 · 1 items

## Critical (1)

- **Technical Amendment to the Regulation Regarding Amendments to Applications** [web search — verify]
  - Tell DEA registration and renewal staff that 21 CFR 1301.16 now explicitly covers renewals, and update procedures so a renewal application isn't treated as withdrawn if the pharmacy asks for it back or doesn't answer DEA correspondence.
  - Deadline: 2026-11-04 (effective, quoted ✓) · Owner: Priya Raman (Pharmacy Operations) · Areas: pharmacy-ops
  - 91 FR 69500 ✓ · https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/04/2026-22484/technical-amendment-to-the-regulation-regarding-amendments-to-applications
